content_sections.heading: 127 Inf Bn TA Eco Garhwal Rifles Vacancy 2026 - Post Details
content_sections.text: The 127 Infantry Battalion (TA) Ecological, Garhwal Rifles has announced 45 vacancies for JCO and Soldier posts in various trades. The post-wise vacancy distribution and eligible states are given below:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for 127 Inf Bn TA Eco Garhwal Rifles Recruitment Rally 2026?
content_sections.text: The recruitment rally is intended for eligible former defence personnel and specified retired women employees of forest-related government departments. The eligibility conditions are as follows: Ex-Servicemen: Former personnel of the Armed Forces, including Territorial Army pension holders, can participate subject to the prescribed service conditions. Ex-Women Employees: Former women employees, including premature retirees, of MoEF & CC and State Forest Departments must have completed at least 20 years of service. Medical Category: Ex-Servicemen must be in SHAPE-I medical category. Character: Candidates must have an Exemplary or Very Good character record. Service Record: Candidates must not be involved in any civil or police case. State Eligibility: JCO (Religious Teacher) vacancies are for Uttarakhand candidates, while the Soldier vacancies are open on an All India basis.

content_sections.heading: 127 Inf Bn TA Eco Garhwal Rifles Recruitment Rally 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification specifies service-related age conditions for eligible Ex-Servicemen. JCO: Can serve up to 55 years of age. Other Ranks (OR): Can serve up to 50 years of age. Enrolment Condition: Candidates should be enrolled within five years from the date of retirement or discharge. Candidates must satisfy the applicable age and service conditions mentioned in the recruitment notice.

content_sections.heading: 127 Inf Bn TA Eco Garhwal Rifles Recruitment Rally 2026 - Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is specified in the published recruitment notice. Candidates are required to attend the recruitment rally directly with their original documents.

content_sections.heading: 127 Inf Bn TA Eco Garhwal Rifles Recruitment Rally 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process differs for Ex-Servicemen and Ex-Women Employees. Candidates will be assessed through the prescribed physical, proficiency, medical and interview stages. Physical Fitness Test: 1.6 km run, beam, 9 feet ditch and balance test. Medical Examination: Candidates shortlisted after the physical test will undergo a medical examination. Interview: Candidates qualifying in the physical and medical examinations will be interviewed by the Board of Officers (BOO). Interview by the Board of Officers (BOO). Proficiency test in afforestation-related activities and nursery management. Medical examination. Final enrolment will be based on merit and the availability of vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for 127 Inf Bn TA Eco Garhwal Rifles Recruitment Rally 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must carry the following original documents when reporting to the recruitment venue. Pension Payment Order (PPO) and Discharge Book. Extended AGI Certificate. Domicile Certificate / Aadhaar Card. Civil Education Certificate. 06 passport-size photographs. Original Pension Order. Certificate from the concerned department confirming 20 years of service. Domicile Certificate / Aadhaar Card. 06 passport-size photographs.

content_sections.heading: How to Attend 127 Inf Bn TA Eco Garhwal Rifles Recruitment Rally 2026
content_sections.text: Read the official recruitment notice carefully and verify the eligibility criteria for the respective post. Check the prescribed service, age, medical and character requirements. Arrange all necessary original documents and passport-size photographs. Visit Jaswant Singh Ground, Garhi Cantt, Dehradun, Uttarakhand . Report for document checking and the physical test on 07 or 08 December 2026 between 06:00 AM and 09:00 AM . Complete document verification and the applicable physical or proficiency tests. Shortlisted candidates must attend the medical examination on 09 or 10 December 2026, as directed by the recruitment authorities. Attend the interview by the Board of Officers wherever applicable.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for Candidates
content_sections.text: The Territorial Army is a volunteer organisation, and regular employment is not guaranteed. Long-term embodiment is not promised under this recruitment. Service rendered in the Ecological Territorial Army Battalion is not pensionable, and no gratuity is admissible. Enrolment depends on merit and the vacancies available. Candidates should beware of touts or individuals demanding money in exchange for recruitment.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in 127 Inf Bn TA Eco Garhwal Rifles Recruitment Rally 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 45 vacancies have been announced for JCO (Religious Teacher), Soldier (GD), Soldier (Clerk SD) and various Soldier Tradesmen posts.

faq.question: Q2. What are the rally dates for 127 Inf Bn TA Eco Garhwal Rifles Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment rally will be held from 07 to 10 December 2026. Document checking and physical tests are scheduled for 07-08 December, followed by medical tests on 09-10 December.

faq.question: Q3. Where will the 127 Inf Bn TA Eco Garhwal Rifles Recruitment Rally 2026 be held?
faq.answer: The recruitment rally will take place at Jaswant Singh Ground, Garhi Cantt, Dehradun, Uttarakhand. Candidates must report between 06:00 AM and 09:00 AM on the designated dates.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible for 127 Inf Bn TA Eco Garhwal Rifles Recruitment Rally 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible Ex-Servicemen from the Armed Forces, including Territorial Army pension holders, and eligible former women employees of MoEF & CC and State Forest Departments can participate, subject to the prescribed service and other eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for 127 Inf Bn TA Eco Garhwal Rifles Recruitment Rally 2026?
faq.answer: As per the notification, JCOs can serve up to 55 years and Other Ranks (OR) up to 50 years. Candidates should also meet the requirement of enrolment within five years from retirement or discharge.

faq.question: Q6. Can candidates from all Indian states attend the recruitment rally?
faq.answer: Yes. The Soldier vacancies are open on an All India basis, while the JCO (Religious Teacher) vacancy is reserved for eligible candidates from Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for 127 Inf Bn TA Eco Garhwal Rifles Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for Ex-Servicemen includes a physical fitness test, medical examination and interview. Eligible Ex-Women Employees will undergo an interview, proficiency test in afforestation-related activities and nursery management, and medical examination.
